about_short_description.short_description: SunFarmer provides solar energy for hospitals, schools, businesses, and farms in developing countries.

product.name: Off-Grid Solar PV Systems
product.description: Standalone power systems using batteries to store energy, providing electricity during non-sunny periods, aimed at industries, hospitals, and remote locations.

product.name: On-Grid Solar Solutions
product.description: Battery-less systems connected to the utility grid, allowing use of solar electricity by day and grid electricity by night, with a net-metering system for excess electricity.

product.name: Solar Water Pumps
product.description: Solar-powered solutions for irrigation and drinking water, designed to replace diesel pumps and provide water in remote areas without power lines.

product.name: Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC)
product.description: End-to-end services from procurement of products to design, installation, and handover of solar projects, including long-term maintenance contracts.

product.name: Asset Management
product.description: Management services for solar projects, focusing on impact investing to power rural schools and health posts.

product.name: Consulting
product.description: Feasibility studies, technical and financial analysis for large-scale solar PV plants in Nepal.
